description:
**Phase G — Tree session integration. Deps: B2, B3, F4.**

Compute `%TreePreparation{target_id, old_leaf_id, common_ancestor_id, entries_to_summarize, user_wants_summary}`.

**`user_wants_summary` is THREE-VALUED** (verified at `tmp/pi-mono/.../interactive-mode.ts:4129`): the prompt is `\"Summarize?\"` with options `[\"Summarize\", \"Summarize with custom prompt\", \"No summary\"]`. So the field is `:no | :yes | {:yes, custom_instructions}`.

Emit `:session_before_tree` event (cancel-on-result; defined at event.ex:27). Extensions may:
- `{:cancel, reason}` → abort navigation.
- Supply `%BranchSummaryResult{}` → only honored when `user_wants_summary != :no`.

If no extension override and `user_wants_summary != :no`, call `generate_branch_summary/2` (F4); when `{:yes, custom_instructions}`, thread the instructions through.

Tests: cancel path; extension-override path; LLM path; no-summary path.
title: G2. Session.navigate_tree/2 + TreePreparation + :session_before_tree dispatch
